title: EXISTENTIAL RISK
slogan: MAY END HUMANITY. RATED STRONG BUY.
joke: The ape pitches investors with a rising chart in one hand and a hazard sign in the other, because the risk-factors page now lists the end of the world right next to strong growth.
alt: The A-OK ape, stamped EXISTENTIAL RISK on an official prospectus form, proudly holds up a rising stock arrow in one hand and a red hazard warning sign in the other.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra, art-directed by Claude

title: TEMPERATURE 2.0
joke: The ape's sampling temperature has been cranked so high he is literally running a fever while still rolling dice for his next word.
alt: The A-OK ape, feverish with a thermometer in his mouth and an ice pack on his cap, flings a handful of dice in front of giant letters reading TEMPERATURE 2.0.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra, art-directed by Claude

title: OVERFITTING
slogan: FITS THE TRAINING DATA. NOTHING ELSE.
joke: The ape has overfitted so hard his hoodie is skin-tight to one exact pose and he can't move at all.
alt: The A-OK ape, squeezed into a hoodie several sizes too small with seams splitting, stands frozen in one stiff pose in front of giant letters reading OVERFITTING.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra, art-directed by Claude

title: CAPTCHA SOLVED
slogan: NOT A ROBOT. NOT A HUMAN. A-OK.
joke: The ape squints at a grid of picture tiles hunting for traffic lights, earnestly trying to prove he is not a robot.
alt: The A-OK ape, as a die-cut sticker on a human verification form stamped CAPTCHA SOLVED, points uncertainly at one square of a big picture-tile grid.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra, art-directed by Claude

title: APE IN THE LOOP
joke: The ape is the human-in-the-loop, taken literally: strapped into a roller-coaster car at the top of a vertical loop, still expected to supervise.
alt: The A-OK ape rides upside down at the top of a roller-coaster loop, clutching a clipboard, under the title APE IN THE LOOP.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude

title: LIMITED PREVIEW
slogan: BEST MODEL EVER. TAKE OUR WORD.
joke: The ape proudly guards a prize-winning masterpiece that nobody is allowed to see, so its first-place ribbon has to be taken entirely on trust.
alt: The A-OK ape stands guard behind a red velvet rope beside a sheet-draped object on a pedestal wearing a giant gold first-place rosette, one palm raised to stop the viewer, under the title LIMITED PREVIEW.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude
